feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 October 2026 10:13pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 03 October 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds in central areas on Sunday.


##Synopsis##

A ridge of high pressure over most of the British Isles. Low to the west of Iceland, moving to the Norwegian Sea, with a new low expected to the southwest of Iceland later.


##Wind##

South or southwest 2 to 4, increasing 4 or 5 overnight and occasionally 6 in central areas tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in central areas, decreasing 3 or 4 Monday evening, veering north or northwest 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then occasional rain later.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, falling moderate in rain.
